title: Chega! The Report of the Commission for Reception, Truth and Reconciliation in Timor-Leste (CAVR)
authors: Commission for Reception, Truth and Reconciliation in Timor-Leste (CAVR)
summary: The comprehensive 2,800-page official truth commission report documenting human rights violations during the Indonesian military occupation of East Timor from 1975 to 1999. The commission verified that between 102,800 and 183,000 Timorese died as a direct consequence of conflict and deprivation, finding that US diplomatic and military support was critical to the Indonesian campaign.
